title: incident-bot: oncall autodiagnostics contextual actions & runbook command helpers
author: Aisha Khan
release_notes: Enhances incident-bot autodiagnostics with contextual suggested actions and runbook command helpers. No breaking changes. Rollout gated behind feature flag.
description:
Context: Recent oncall incidents highlighted that SREs and product oncall often need quick, actionable remediation steps surfaced directly in incident-bot alongside diagnostics. This PR adds a new 'contextual actions' layer to the autodiagnostics pipeline and small runbook helper commands that make it trivial to attach recommended runbook snippets to oncall messages.

Motivation: reduce time-to-first-action and provide a safe, auditable set of suggested steps that are ranked by confidence and past-success telemetry.

What this PR does:
- Adds a contextual action ranking module that consumes autodiagnostics output and SLO/alert metadata to produce up to 3 suggested remediation actions with confidence scores.
- Introduces runbook helper commands ("/rb-attach", "/rb-snippet") so responders can quickly attach pre-approved runbook snippets to an incident chat or Slack thread.
- Adds telemetry hooks to track suggestion acceptance, execution (via runbook links), and post-action SLO deltas for feedback.
- Integrates with existing SLO toolkit utilities to fetch correlated runbooks and historical runbook effectiveness metrics.
- Implements a feature flag (incident_bot.autodiag_actions) and safe rollout plan: opt-in by team, staged ramp to 50% oncall rotation over two weeks, full enablement after monitoring window.

Implementation notes:
- New files: actions/ranking.py (action scorer), actions/api.py (exposed endpoint), slack/commands/runbook_helpers.py (command handlers), templates/runbook_snippets.yaml (approved snippets), handlers/oncall_message_enricher.py (attaches suggestions to existing oncall message flow).
- The ranking uses a lightweight heuristic ensemble (SLO impact estimate, historical success rate, time-to-recover median) and falls back to a deterministic safe ordering when telemetry is sparse.
- All runbook snippets are referenced by ID; actual content is fetched on-demand and permission-checked using existing RBAC flows.

Testing and validation:
- Unit tests for ranking heuristics and command handlers added.
- End-to-end test simulating an oncall alert with autodiagnostics -> suggestions -> user acceptance path.
- Manual smoke testing with the SRE oncall rotation; acceptance metrics recorded.

Migration and rollout:
- No DB migrations required.
- Feature flag gate added; default off for all customers.
- Ops playbook updated with rollout checklist and telemetry dashboards to monitor suggestion acceptance rate and any regression in MTTR.

Security and compliance:
- Runbook snippet fetches are permission-checked against team-scoped RBAC.
- All suggested actions are logged with context for auditability.

Notes for reviewers:
- Review the ranking heuristics for any edge cases where confidence is misestimated.
- Verify RBAC checks in runbook_helpers.py.
- Confirm telemetry names and labels align with observability conventions (see observability-pack ticket linked).

Related work: ENG-4492 (autodiagnostics core refactor), ENG-4510 (slo-toolkit runbook effectiveness metrics).
